text:
```yaml
name: Test CI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      platform:
        description: 'Select the platform'
        required: true
        options:
          - macOS
          - Linux
          - Windows

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [macOS, Linux, Windows]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        profile: minimal
        toolchain: stable
        override: true

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        cargo update
        cargo build --release

    - name: Run tests
      run: cargo test --release

    - name: Upload coverage report
      uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        directory: target/release/deps
```
